name: 無底板浮動頁首（標誌＋選單按鈕）→ 捲動後右側出現導覽容器
desc: 沒有底板、固定在畫面頂端的頁首。在頁面頂端只有標誌和選單按鈕；往下捲動後右側出現一個有底色的獨立容器，裝著橫向的導覽連結和選單按鈕。選單按鈕打開全螢幕面板，桌機各組橫向並排成數欄、手機上下直排。
prompt: 建立一個和畫面邊緣有距離的浮動頁首，固定在畫面頂端。頁首沒有底板，標誌與選單按鈕各自直接放在頁面上；頁首和上方、左右兩側都有距離，寬度接近整個畫面寬，只有標誌和選單按鈕，導覽連結全部收進選單面板：標誌在左、選單按鈕在右，兩者垂直置中在同一水平線上。往下捲動約一個畫面高度後，頁首改變外形：標誌與選單按鈕移到更靠近畫面左右邊緣的位置，內容不受頁面內容寬度限制；右側出現一個有自己底色的獨立容器，約佔畫面寬的一半多，四個角（左上、右上、左下、右下）都做圓角，和標誌在同一水平線上，導覽連結在容器內橫向排列，選單按鈕移進容器內的最右端；標誌仍然沒有底板。往下或往上捲動時頁首都不隱藏。導覽項目有子項目時，項目旁有一個小圖示，滑過後在該項目下方展開一欄子連結。點選單按鈕後，展開蓋住整個畫面的選單面板，選單按鈕在原位變成關閉按鈕，面板內不放標誌；導覽連結分組放在面板上半部，各組橫向並排成數欄、從左側開始排列，每組是一個大的群組標題，下方直向列出較小的子連結；面板打開時各欄由左到右依序淡入。
mobile: 捲動前後頁首上都只留標誌在左、選單按鈕在右，沒有底板；捲動後兩者移到更靠近畫面邊緣的位置，但不出現導覽容器；往下或往上捲動都不隱藏的行為保留。導覽連結收進選單面板：點選單按鈕後，展開蓋住整個畫面的選單面板，選單按鈕在原位變成關閉按鈕，面板內不放標誌；各組改為上下直向排列並靠左，每組是一個大的群組標題，下方直向列出較小的子連結，面板打開時各組由上到下依序淡入。觸控裝置上取消滑過展開的子選單，子連結在面板內直接全部列出。

en.name: Floating header with no backing (logo + menu button) → navigation container appears on the right after scrolling
en.desc: A header with no backing, fixed to the top of the viewport. At the top of the page it holds only the logo and a menu button; after scrolling down a separate container with its own backing appears on the right, holding the horizontal navigation links and the menu button. The menu button opens a full-viewport panel whose groups sit side by side in columns on desktop and stack vertically on mobile.
en.prompt: Create a floating header inset from the viewport edges, fixed to the top of the viewport. The header has no backing: the logo and the menu button sit directly on the page. The header is inset from the top, left and right edges and spans nearly the full width of the viewport, with only the logo and a menu button, with all navigation links inside the menu panel: the logo on the left and the menu button on the right, vertically centered on the same horizontal line. After scrolling down about one viewport height, the header changes shape: the logo and the menu button move closer to the left and right edges of the viewport, the content not limited to the page content width; a separate container with its own backing appears on the right, spanning a little over half of the viewport width, with all four corners (top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right) rounded, on the same horizontal line as the logo; the navigation links are laid out horizontally inside it, and the menu button moves into the right end of the container; the logo still has no backing. The header never hides, whether scrolling down or up. When a navigation item has children, a small icon sits beside the item, and hovering it opens a single column of sublinks below that item. Clicking the menu button opens a menu panel covering the entire viewport; the menu button turns into a close button in the same place, and the panel does not contain the logo. The navigation links are grouped in the upper part of the panel, with the groups placed side by side in several columns starting from the left; each group is a large group heading with smaller sublinks stacked vertically below it. When the panel opens, the columns fade in one after another from left to right.
en.mobile: Before and after scrolling the header keeps only the logo on the left and the menu button on the right, with no backing; after scrolling both move closer to the viewport edges, but no navigation container appears; the header still never hides, whether scrolling down or up. The navigation links move into the menu panel: tapping the menu button opens a menu panel covering the entire viewport; the menu button turns into a close button in the same place, and the panel does not contain the logo. Inside the panel the groups are stacked vertically and left-aligned: each group is a large group heading with smaller sublinks stacked vertically below it, and the groups fade in one after another from top to bottom when the panel opens. On touch devices the hover submenu is dropped and all sublinks are listed directly in the panel.
